name: Solenne Neuralcrest Port Fascinator III
description: A sculptural Spire fascinator built around a hand-formed bioluminescent resin base in deep verdigris, mounted to a carved bone-analogue comb. The centerpiece is a precision-machined open lattice of white-gold-plated brass that frames and ornaments exposed neural-port hardware rather than concealing it — ports glow amber through the lattice at night. Trailing filaments of bioprogrammed silk catch light and pulse faintly in sync with the wearer's BCI activity. Each piece is unique.
functionality: Purely ornamental with one exception: the lattice is machined to accommodate and display standard Axiom, Pragma, and TESSERA neural-port hardware without snagging. The bioprogrammed silk pulses in response to BCI signal output, making augmentation visible as aesthetic performance.
what_it_says: Your chrome is not a concession to utility — it is the centerpiece, and you paid someone extraordinary to say so.
story_hooks: Two Spire attendees arrived at the same governance gala wearing Solenne III fascinators whose silk filaments pulsed in perfect synchrony — suggesting either their BCIs were communicating, or both had been hacked from the same source.

A Solenne atelier apprentice is secretly selling 3D scans of bespoke commissions to a Tier 2 fabricator who is reproducing them in cheap resin — the copies are spreading down the tiers faster than Solenne can issue cease orders.
The bone-analogue comb material in the last six pieces tested positive for actual human bone matrix — Solenne has not responded to inquiries.

physical_description.visual_profile: An avant-garde sculptural fascinator that transforms neural-port hardware into haute couture. The piece sits atop the head like a crown of precision engineering and living art, with the wearer's exposed port becoming the focal point rather than something hidden. The trailing silk filaments create an ethereal, almost living quality that moves with thought and intention.
physical_description.fit: Secured via an intricately carved bone-analogue comb that integrates directly into the hair at the crown and sides of the head. Form-fitted to the specific geometry of the wearer's port hardware, requiring bespoke measurement. The fascinator portion rests lightly, distributing weight across the comb structure.
physical_description.primary_material: Bioluminescent resin base (deep verdigris), white-gold-plated brass lattice framework, bone-analogue comb, bioprogrammed silk filaments, exposed neural-port hardware (integrated, not part of garment)
physical_description.texture: The resin base has an organic, slightly waxy surface with depth that shifts in light. The brass lattice is polished mirror-smooth with precision-cut edges. Silk filaments are gossamer-thin with a subtle iridescent sheen, pulsing with faint bioluminescence. Comb is carved with micro-relief detail.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep verdigris-green resin base with warm amber bioluminescence emanating from port hardware at night. White-gold brass provides cool metallic contrast. Silk filaments shift between pearl, champagne, and pale amber depending on movement and neural activity.
physical_description.closures: Integrated comb structure — no external closures. The piece is secured through precise fit into the wearer's hair and neural-port cavity, requiring professional fitting.
distinctive_features: Open lattice design that showcases rather than conceals neural-port hardware
Amber bioluminescence from ports visible through lattice framework at night
Bioprogrammed silk filaments that pulse in sync with wearer's brain-computer interface activity
Hand-formed verdigris resin with organic depth and variation
Carved bone-analogue comb with micro-relief detailing
Each piece entirely unique and bespoke — no two are identical
Precision-machined brass components toleranced to individual port specifications
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury — Solenne Spire atelier pieces command Φ180,000-350,000 at auction. Bespoke commission only, accessible exclusively to wealthy corpo elite and high-tier independent operators.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals not just wealth but a specific philosophy: the wearer is confident enough in their augmentation to make it art rather than hide it. Worn by corpo executives, neurosurgeons, elite hackers, and artistic patrons who view their neural enhancements as identity markers rather than shameful modifications. Declares refinement, transhumanist ideology, and access to the most exclusive fabricators in the GLMZ.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always pristine and meticulously maintained. The bioluminescent resin requires specialized care to prevent degradation. Worn only for significant occasions — galas, board presentations, artistic performances, high-stakes negotiations. Never weathered or patched, as this would diminish its artistic and monetary value.
